messages:
jen-partners: Quick heads-up 1: CloudScale dropped the final co-marketing package (case study PDF, marketplace tile, 2 hero images). We want to publish next Tue. Need quick brand + legal oks. Files in thread.
marco-marketing: Just skimmed the PDF 1: looks solid. Can we tighten the hero headline to remove superlatives? Partner used 'industry-leading' a bunch.
meera-design: Noted. Two design issues: 1) partner supplied raster logo only (PNG), we need SVGs for the marketplace tile; 2) their hero image has a subtle gradient behind the mark which may violate our lockup rules.
oscar-legal: LOA reminder: any customer names or quotes require written permission. I see a customer quote in the case study that mentions a paying customer by name. Do we have explicit opt-in?
sophia-ops: Partner slack thread says customer cleared the quote but didn't attach email. Can partner paste the approval or upload the signed note.
jen-partners: I'll ask CloudScale for the signed approval and SVGs. Also ask them to remove gradient or provide a solid background alternative.
marco-marketing: Marketplace tile guidance: keep CTAs consistent with our catalog 1: 'Get started' or 'Learn more' only. Which one do we prefer here?
meera-design: For conversion we should use 'Get started' on the tile and 'Download case study' on the PDF CTA. Also recommend compact badge bottom-left for marketplace tile.
asset-bot: Uploaded: cloudscale-case-v3.pdf (1.8MB), market-tile-cloudscale-v2.png (420KB), cloudscale-badge.png (48KB)
oscar-legal: PDF note: the quote includes a metric ("50% faster inference"). Metrics tied to customers are risky unless we have the partner's verification. Ask CloudScale to switch to 'up to' phrasing if they can't provide a signed data source.
jen-partners: Sent partner message: requesting SVGs, signed quote approval, and a solid-background hero. They replied: "Can provide SVG & signed quote, gradient is part of our photography package though." They've agreed to export a solid BG variant.
meera-design: I'll mock the solid-bg hero and a reversed white badge. Uploading three quick comps now: cs-hero-solid-left-redwood-right.png, cs-hero-solid-alt.png, badge-compact-white.svg
marco-marketing: Also check localization: partner asked for en-US + en-GB variants. For en-GB we need date formats and spelling. Who owns copy edits?
jen-partners: I'll coordinate with their PM for en-GB copy. We should route final copy to oscar-legal for sign-off before publishing.
oscar-legal: Fine. Also confirm trademark lockup: partner wants to put their mark larger than ours in the hero 1: that's okay if it's visually balanced, but we must stick to our clearspace rules (12px min). Send me the export with measurements.
sophia-ops: For marketplace upload: we need alt text, 72dpi PNG, and a 1:1 thumbnail + 16:9 hero. Add the metadata: category tags, short blurb (max 150 chars).
meera-design: Alt text drafts: "Redwood Inference and CloudScale co-branded solution for scalable inference" and "Co-developed inference pipeline by CloudScale and Redwood". Any preference?
marco-marketing: First one feels better for SEO. Keep blurb under 150 chars: "CloudScale + Redwood Inference: faster throughput, lower cost for production LLMs."
enoscar-legal: Minor tweak: avoid definitive claims like 'lower cost' without a qualifier. Suggest: "CloudScale + Redwood Inference: faster throughput and reduced inference cost for some production LLM workloads."
jen-partners: Partner uploaded signed quote approval and SVGs to the email thread. Also sent en-GB copy.
asset-bot: Uploaded: cloudscale-badge-compact.svg (8KB), cs-hero-solid-left-redwood-right.png (900KB), cloudscale-logo.svg (45KB)
meera-design: Ran WCAG check: tile white-on-dark passes AA, hero overlay text needs to be 18px+ to meet AA. I'll remove small caption from hero.
marco-marketing: Great. Next steps: 1) meera to finalize assets by EOD today; 2) oscar to confirm legal OK on final phrasing/code; 3) jen to confirm partner sign-off on final comps and schedule marketplace publish for Tue; 4) sophia to prep upload checklist.
jen-partners: Thanks team 1: ping me if anything blocks.
__notes: Single Slack thread string per agents.md. No title field included.
